fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-04-04, members of a chit group near Nallur Nagar Main Street reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 1,20,000. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-03-16 at roughly 13:30. The account reference SYN-ACC-100005 was noted in connection with the payment. A second person, Senthil Natarajan (9000000262), was also mentioned as possibly present. The complainant alleged that Harish Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000180. Padmini Raj (9000000032) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Mathan Raman (9000000187), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, mobile number, afternoon, witness, suspect, receiving account, main street
